art_note: Clean studio product shots, but lifestyle images feature standard print-on-demand flat compositing.
desc_en: An intimate piece designed to express identity and style without sacrificing comfort. This silhouette stands out with its striking all-over print inspired by the American flag, combining a navy blue background with stars and undulating stripes that bring movement. Equipped with a comfortable elastic waistband and contrasting binding, the garment is finished with the emblematic monogram on the front. Crafted on demand in limited units with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Una pieza íntima concebida para expresar identidad y estilo sin sacrificar el confort. Esta silueta destaca por su llamativo estampado integral inspirado en la bandera estadounidense, combinando un fondo azul marino con estrellas y franjas ondulantes que aportan movimiento. Equipada con una confortable cinturilla elástica y ribetes en contraste, la prenda se completa con el monograma emblemático en el frontal. Fabricada bajo demanda en unidades limitadas con envío a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: 97% polyester, 3% spandex
· Fabric weight: 180 g/m² (5.3 oz/yd²)
· Antimicrobial and breathable fabric
· Elastic waistband and black binding
· DAZ seal on the upper front
· Made-to-order assembly in the US
